# dsh-frozen

Reserved name — in development.

A prompt-cache guardian plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): cache-hit accounting per turn and a live HUD next to the official stats line.

即将到来：dsh 的 prompt cache 守护插件——逐轮缓存命中对账 + 官方统计行旁的实时 HUD。

By the authors of `dsh-memory-pyramid`.
